catalog.name: Local Group
catalog.description: Our galaxy group, including the Milky Way, Andromeda and their neighboring galaxies.

facts.label: Centre
facts.value: Midway between the Milky Way and M31
facts.note: The paper places the Local Group's barycentre at the mid-point of the vector connecting the two (Table 2, notes to columns 8 to 10); the marker uses this repository's positions of the Galactic centre and M31.

source.label: McConnachie (2012), The Observed Properties of Dwarf Galaxies in and around the Local Group, AJ 144, 4

facts.label: Distance to the centre
facts.note: The Sun's distance from that mid-point, from the same two positions.

source.label: McConnachie (2012), The Observed Properties of Dwarf Galaxies in and around the Local Group, AJ 144, 4

facts.label: Zero-velocity radius
facts.note: The mean distance of the galaxies at the group's zero-velocity surface (section 3).

source.label: McConnachie (2012), The Observed Properties of Dwarf Galaxies in and around the Local Group, AJ 144, 4
